queries: WITH per_type AS (SELECT e.type AS event_type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_ratio FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.spent IS NOT NULL AND b.amount IS NOT NULL AND b.amount <> 0 GROUP BY e.type) SELECT event_type, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM per_type) AS diff_from_mean_of_averages FROM per_type ORDER BY event_type;

WITH per_type AS (SELECT e.type AS type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_spent_ratio FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.spent IS NOT NULL AND b.amount IS NOT NULL AND b.amount <> 0 GROUP BY e.type) SELECT type, avg_spent_ratio, avg_spent_ratio - AVG(avg_spent_ratio) OVER () AS diff_from_mean_of_averages FROM per_type ORDER BY type;

responses.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT e.type AS event_type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_ratio FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.spent IS NOT NULL AND b.amount IS NOT NULL AND b.amount <> 0 GROUP BY e.type) SELECT event_type, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM per_type) AS diff_from_mean_of_averages FROM per_type ORDER BY event_type;

assumptions.assumption: Budget lines with NULL spent or NULL amount are excluded, and lines with amount = 0 are excluded to avoid division by zero.
The 'mean of the per-type averages' is the unweighted average of the per-type average ratios (each type counts equally), and the difference is signed (type average minus that mean).
Budget lines whose link_to_event has no matching event are dropped (inner join); events with a NULL type form their own group.

responses.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT e.type AS type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_spent_ratio FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.spent IS NOT NULL AND b.amount IS NOT NULL AND b.amount <> 0 GROUP BY e.type) SELECT type, avg_spent_ratio, avg_spent_ratio - AVG(avg_spent_ratio) OVER () AS diff_from_mean_of_averages FROM per_type ORDER BY type;

assumptions.assumption: Budget lines with amount = 0 are excluded because the ratio is undefined, along with lines where spent or amount is NULL. Budget lines with no matching event are dropped by the inner join.
The 'mean of the per-type averages' is the unweighted mean across event types, so each type counts equally regardless of its number of budget lines. Distance is signed (type average minus that mean).

responses.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT e.type AS type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_spent_ratio FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.type) SELECT type, avg_spent_ratio, avg_spent_ratio - AVG(avg_spent_ratio) OVER () AS diff_from_mean_of_averages FROM per_type ORDER BY type

assumptions.assumption: Budget lines with a zero amount give a NULL ratio in SQLite (division by zero), so they are ignored along with lines where spent or amount is NULL.
Budget lines are joined to events with an inner join, so lines without a matching event are excluded. Events with a NULL type, if any, form their own group.
The mean of the per-type averages is an unweighted mean over the types that have a non-NULL average, and each type's difference is its average minus that mean.
